campaign.name: ACTS Seeding owned-static v4 Development pilot
campaign.phase: scientific execution complete; Genesis restored; rendering archive report

corrections.observed: The first immutable-template freeze stopped before creating the template because Ninja was not on the persistent container shell PATH.
corrections.resolution: Source the pinned LCG 105 environment in template freeze and final restore helpers before Ninja and import checks.

corrections.observed: Genesis process 1 completed validly, but record preparation rejected the correction evidence because nested JSON keys were not in canonical order.
corrections.resolution: Canonicalize correction evidence and make the Genesis helper resume from the preserved valid result without rerunning its scientific process.

corrections.observed: The candidate helper initially assigned scientific process time to record preparation and ended preparation before identity generation.
corrections.resolution: End preparation after candidate identity proof and measure record preparation only from scientific process completion through strict result parsing.

corrections.observed: The first slot 1 preparation restored the immutable template to a different logical candidate path, so the CMake home-directory identity check rejected it before invalidation or build.
corrections.resolution: Use the original configured /slot logical source and build paths for every reflink reset, as required by the accepted workspace contract; retain the failed preparation workspace separately.

corrections.authorization: Captain authorized this pre-scientific correction and confirmed that it does not consume the no-repeat allowance.
corrections.observed: Candidate invalidation invokes Ninja, but the candidate helper loaded the pinned LCG environment only after invalidation, so the second preparation attempt stopped before build or scientific execution.
corrections.resolution: Load the pinned LCG environment before invalidation and retain it for invalidation, build, and the post-build dry run. Add a regression test for this command ordering and environment lifetime.

corrections.observed: The generated ACTS Python setup reads ZSH_VERSION without a default and exited under Bash nounset after the complete candidate build and identity proof, before the scientific process command was created.
corrections.phase: slot 1 preparation after build and before scientific execution
corrections.resolution: Match the qualified Genesis runner by disabling nounset only while sourcing the generated Python setup, then restore nounset before scientific execution. Add a regression test for the shell option boundary.

compatibility.assessment: The parents change separate layouts: core space-point variance storage versus triplet-candidate kinematics storage. They share no files or symbols and preserve the same exact diagnostics.

eligibility.promising_predecessor: PackedVarianceColumnsV4 was valid, directionally faster, and inconclusive under the fixed envelope.

proposal.expected_hot_path: Core space-point construction and paired variance loads, followed by triplet candidate insertion, sorting, and compatible-seed filtering.
proposal.falsifier: The timing prediction fails unless the combination is confidently faster under the fixed Genesis empirical noise envelope; any exact count or event-hash change violates the physics prediction.
proposal.hypothesis: Combining the compatible packed core variance layout with paired triplet kinematics will improve locality at two independent seeding stages without changing seed selection or truth matching.
proposal.novelty_reason: This is the first owned-static v4 measurement of these two compatible passed predecessors together. The combined mechanism key has not appeared in prior records.
